content: Butoconazole nitrate vaginal cream, marketed under the brand name GYNAZOLE-1®, is a pharmaceutical preparation containing 2% butoconazole nitrate. This compound is an imidazole derivative with antifungal properties, specifically designed for the treatment of fungal infections. Butoconazole nitrate exhibits limited solubility in methanol, slight solubility in chloroform, methylene chloride, acetone, and ethanol, very slight solubility in ethyl acetate, and is practically insoluble in water. The compound decomposes upon melting at approximately 159°C. The cream formulation of GYNAZOLE-1® includes 2% butoconazole nitrate as the active ingredient, combined with a base containing the following excipients: disodium edetate, glyceryl monoisostearate, methylparaben, mineral oil, polyglyceryl-3 oleate, propylene glycol, propylparaben, colloidal silicon dioxide, sorbitol solution, purified water, and microcrystalline wax. These components are carefully selected to ensure the stability, efficacy, and proper delivery of the active antifungal agent.
